label: Feature-13
title: Schema Extensions
description:
Add new node types to support richer project planning.

## New Node Types
- `version` - Release milestone
- `user-story` - User need / scenario  
- `person` - Team member / assignee

## New Link Types
- `has-feature` / `feature-of`
- `has-task` / `task-of`
- `has-story` / `story-of`
- `assigned-to` / `assignee-of`
